_purpose: Measurement regions for the contradiction test, in 752x1024 twin pixels. DEFINED BEFORE EITHER IMAGE EXISTS, from the BRACER twin, which shares the byte-matched control image (20,973 px; canny 15,325 + contour 9,958) and therefore the pose. A box placed on one twin from this control sits on the same structure in any other.
_placement: First pass placed by eye on the full frame, then five boxes were tightened against 2-3x zooms (pauldron, medallion/skirt, crossguard, blade, knees) because they were catching adjacent structure. The tightening happened BEFORE either measured image existed and is recorded here rather than in a shell history.
_why_shown: N11's gold-pixel count was thrown away because its crop caught the pauldron edge and inverted the truth. The fix is not a cleverer crop, it is SHOWING the crop: every box is drawn and labelled on the sheet, and every row reports the BASE image's own median colour inside the box so a reader can check the box is sitting on what it claims (e08_deltaE.py's pattern). Boxes are additionally intersected with the exact mesh silhouette, so background inside a box is excluded.
_class: contra = counted in the denominator | coloc = substituted for prompt coherence, reported outside the denominator | held = not contradicted, internal control
